findings.text: follow-on: the widened predicate's only callers are census_signal_roles and backfill_signal_roles (parallel.py:2007 and parallel.py:2035), which are invoked only from tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py and the node's own measurement script, so no CLI or MCP entry point drives the backfill sweep; the widened predicate reaches production only through the enrich-worker judgement branch at parallel.py:5233.

follow-on: the declared negative control removes the underspecified status from the role predicate, which reddens only the two predicate tests (test_sweep_and_census_share_one_predicate and test_underspecified_signal_is_a_role_candidate, per negative-control.log); test_enrichment_judges_an_underspecified_signal, which guards the enrich-worker judgement block at parallel.py:5233, has no applied mutation log showing it reddens when that block is reverted, so its falsifiability rests on reading the guard rather than on a recorded red arm.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base 7bbf44b5663c71078d6f94f84901867ba98430b8; commit 6e02044bbdb9ac0312d8669ab84e8a3929a65e4d changes the shared role predicate and adds the enrich-worker judgement call (parallel.py:1916 and parallel.py:5233), commit 9685f20f6019765b8a9c7efecf15dc8157d9ee6c adds the evidence fragment; 336 insertions and 34 deletions across parallel.py, tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py and the fragment, and no figure.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when requires the predicate to admit underspecified, the store test to read the production Cypher, a new test for each half, the JT-60SA signals judged before any write with a seeded 30-sample agreement at a 27/30 bar, the census before and after, and spend under USD 0.05; the manifest records agreement 29/30 with the one disagreement listed (logs/agreement.json), census missing 210 before and 0 after over n=15111 (logs/store_result.json), spend USD 0.0053928 (logs/judge-no-store.log), and head gates 7 passed and 1575 passed EXIT=0 (logs/gate-head.log, logs/gate-discovery-head.log), each re-checked on disk.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to store a judged signal_role on every described signal the enrichment marks underspecified; imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:1916 adds 'underspecified' to _SIGNAL_ROLE_MISSING_WHERE and parallel.py:5233 has the enrich worker judge and store a role for the underspecified signals it marks, beside the enriched branch it already served at parallel.py:5294.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 6e02044bbdb9ac0312d8669ab84e8a3929a65e4d and 9685f20f6019765b8a9c7efecf15dc8157d9ee6c, changed_paths the three declared repository paths, tests '7 passed' and '1575 passed, 8 deselected' with EXIT=0, negative_control_log logs/negative-control.log reading 2 failed EXIT=1, and baseline_suite and after_suite both null, so the head arm is green with zero failures and no base arm was recorded.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py, tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py, docs/evidence/fragments/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/ssfms-underspecified-roles.html and the figures directory docs/figures/signal-search-finds-the-measured-signal/ssfms-underspecified-roles; the diff's three changed paths are exactly the first three and no figure was written, so every path is inside the fence.

justifications.durability: the two predicate tests redden under the declared mutation (negative-control.log: 2 failed, EXIT=1), and tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py:417 asserts the enrich worker judged the underspecified signal so it fails if the block at parallel.py:5233 is removed, though that half has no recorded mutation; the double at tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py:39 now selects from the Cypher each statement carries, so a predicate drift is visible.
justifications.evidence: the done-when's figures are recorded on disk and re-checked: logs/agreement.json (agree 29 of n 30), logs/store_result.json (missing 210 to 0, n 15111), logs/judge-no-store.log (cost 0.00539288) and the two head gate logs reading 7 passed and 1575 passed EXIT=0; the 'against base' half rests on the green head arm alone because the reviewed run recorded neither baseline_suite nor after_suite.
justifications.fit: the added block at imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:5233 mirrors the enriched branch at parallel.py:5294 including its role_cost guard, the test helpers at tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py:31 and :39 follow the file's docstringed style, and no added name carries a version, plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: parallel.py:1916 admits 'underspecified' and parallel.py:5233 stores a role for the underspecified signals the worker marks, and the live census moved from 210 missing to 0 over n=15111, so the described underspecified signals now carry a stored role.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the shared predicate owner _SIGNAL_ROLE_MISSING_WHERE (parallel.py:1916) and reuses the existing judge_and_store_signal_roles (parallel.py:1958) rather than forking a judgement path; a search of tests/ for an existing candidate-read predicate evaluator found none, so the double at tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py:39 is the first and does not duplicate an owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff against 7bbf44b5 (imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py, tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py and the fragment) is one of the manifest's declared write paths, with no other file touched and no unused figure added.
